Alpha 1.79.29 (Complete jump pose continuity)

  • Removed a remaining pose snap as characters untuck midway through a jump. Takeoff, roll and landing now ease smoothly between poses.
  • Starting a jump retires any earlier walking correction, preventing a pull back toward takeoff after landing.
  • The first server acknowledgement now renders the current jump position immediately, eliminating a brief backward snap at takeoff.
  • Includes smooth jump prediction and sparse network updates, the Well Rested aura tracking fix and correct separation of automation accounts in administration.
  • Long jumps retain 1.3 seconds of flight for approximately 1.5-second total arrival. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.28 (Smooth jumps and auras)

  • Jump takeoff, flight and landing now share a continuous animation clock. Server acceptance preserves the takeoff pose, and sparse updates keep motion smooth while long jumps retain 1.3 seconds of flight.
  • Characters ease into their jump and return upright on contact, with a smooth landing recovery.
  • The Well Rested aura follows the character's rendered position while walking and jumping.
  • Administration correctly separates automation accounts from real players in online lists, activity history and daily totals. All accounts remain available through the population filter.
  • Includes the recent faster jump arrival, world-entry recovery and combat stability fixes. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.27 (Faster jump arrival)

  • Long Ctrl-click jumps now use 1.3 seconds of flight, leaving room for network and rendering delay within an approximately 1.5-second total from click to landing. Nearby hops stay quick.
  • Elapsed-time flight keeps jumps responsive at low frame rates, with the same server-checked destinations and terrain boundaries.
  • Improved release validation for earned room rewards delivered when selling or storing gear frees bag space.
  • Includes the recent world-entry download recovery and combat stability corrections. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.26 (Maintenance and validation)

  • Improved release checks for delayed Gold updates when selling or storing spare gear.
  • Long Ctrl-click jumps retain their 1.5-second flight, including at low frame rates. Nearby hops stay quick.
  • Includes the recent world-entry download recovery and combat stability corrections.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.25 (Consistent jump timing)

  • Long Ctrl-click jumps follow elapsed time and reach their destination after 1.5 seconds of flight, including at low frame rates. Nearby hops stay quick.
  • Jump display smoothing now follows elapsed time too, keeping the character closer to its landing point during slow frames.
  • World entry can recover once from an interrupted engine download. Persistent download failures show reload guidance.
  • Improved server stability when players cast abilities during combat.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.24 (Reliable scene transforms)

  • Corrected stale scene-object positions during scene updates, including attached objects.
  • Jump travel retains its 1.5-second cap. Saved progress, collision, character models and equipment remain unchanged.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.23 (Faster jumps)

  • Long Ctrl-click jumps now take at most 1.5 seconds from takeoff to the landing point, down from three seconds. Nearby short hops stay quick.
  • Client prediction and the authoritative server share the new timing. Jump arcs, destination constraints and saved progress remain unchanged.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.22 (Actor lighting correctness)

  • Procedural fallback characters and Skeletons retain correct surface lighting when a stretched animation hierarchy produces shear. Unsupported transforms use the original mesh renderer rather than the instance shader’s inaccurate normal approximation; normal rotations and ordinary nonuniform scale retain batching.
  • Live animation and equipment transforms remain responsive. Original materials, triangles, visibility and shadow behavior are retained, including returning to batching when a pose becomes supported again.
  • Focused native High/Low comparisons cover Skeletons and ten fully equipped procedural characters spanning all four classes. Existing pixel, triangle and visibility limits remain unchanged. Unsupported poses intentionally retain original draw counts; this is a correctness fix, not a frame-rate claim.
  • Supplied rigged GLBs, fitted equipment, gameplay, rewards and saved progress remain unchanged. Full modern-world art, equipped-party and physical-device qualification remain ongoing; raised terrain is still disabled by default.
  • Full prior patch history is retained; login shows ten notes initially with Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.21 (Working town details)

  • Lanternhold’s common well has an open wooden bucket, iron bands and bail, a winding drum, rope and crank. Its existing stone basin, safe-zone recovery, walking space and ambient worker behavior are retained.
  • Courtyard benches use separated timber slats with modest beveled edges and back supports. The same thirteen walking footprints, material batches and scene-owned resource cleanup remain; no new obstacles, texture maps or per-frame animation work.
  • Votive Market gains curved provision casks with iron hoops under its canopy. Casks and the supply chest meet the actual stone platform; stacked shipping crates meet each other rather than overlapping or sinking into the plinth. Existing market bounds, services and walking routes remain unchanged.
  • The town review uses the delivered dressed Archmage Ilyra appearance rather than an inaccurate bare player Wizard stand-in. This corrects the review scene; the live story NPC already uses that outfit.
  • Credits & notices on login opens a small, script-free page linking the original browser-library, Cinzel font and four supplied character-source notices, plus Ilyra’s source information. It does not load game models or grant a new project license.
  • Native visual QA retains character, environment and celebration screenshots separately, so later release-smoke commands do not erase them. Existing checks, render limits and optional/full-test choices are unchanged; retained evidence is scanned before upload.
  • This scoped town refinement is not final modern-world art, equipped-party or physical-device acceptance. Original rendering limits remain unchanged. Raised terrain remains disabled by default; broader world, character and performance work continues.
  • Supplied class, equipment and animation assets, gameplay, rewards, permissions and saved progress remain unchanged. Full prior patch history is retained; login shows ten notes initially with Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.20 (Pilgrim camps and worn streets)

  • Lanternhold camps have folded leather bedrolls with rolled ends instead of floating boxes. Hearth stones meet the ground and firewood stacks physically, using existing timber and leather material batches.
  • Charcoal follows each actual rotated hearth, and compacted ground connects tent entrances to their hearths. Both are baked into the existing ground mask: no decals, extra textures, draw calls or per-frame work.
  • Town roads use larger irregular flagstones instead of uniform brick-like paving. Unequal courses, chipped corners and short worn fractures share one periodic layout across color, relief and roughness. High and Low preserve the same slab sizes and joints, without new textures, geometry or shader samples.
  • All 15 camp placements, rotations, nine material batches, walking blockers and service paths remain unchanged. The detailed camp props add 3,300 raw triangles across the entire town; original reference-view budgets remain unchanged.
  • Native High/Low equipped town views qualify this scoped update, not final modern-world art, sustained equipped-party or physical-device performance. Raised terrain remains disabled by default; broader art and performance work continues.
  • Supplied actor, equipment and animation assets, combat, rewards, account permissions and saved progress remain unchanged. Full prior patch history is retained; login shows ten notes initially with Load more notes.
